  VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) { Table(columns: ["Name", "Status"], rows: [["Ana Lima", "Active"], ["Ben Okafor", "Away"]]).variant("bleed"); Text("bleed").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
}
